row.title: GH mirror catches up in rounds (MIRROR-CATCHUP-1)
row.body: The mirror write count paces GitHub's secondary rate. When a run defers writes, foundation/ghmirror.py now plans again and continues for up to 10 rounds or 8 minutes. Evidence: tests/foundation/test_ghmirror.py passes, and a manual apply run closed 252 issues (336 to 41 open) in one session. Rule: close an item in docs/issues first with queue.close and evidence, because the mirror follows the file.
